# How far a target with no host language unrolls a loop over a constant
# iterable.
#
# A static artifact holds the iterations themselves, so it unrolls at any size
# up to a bound, past which it says so rather than writing a page nobody
# wanted. Which targets unroll at all is testdata/unroll_static_only.txtar.

! sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out big big.sngl
stderr 'repeats 200000 times'
stderr 'build for a target that can run the loop'

# The same program is fine on a target that can run the loop -- and a count
# from zero is Go's range over an int.
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out bigtui big.sngl
grep 'for range 200000 \{' bigtui/model.go

-- big.sngl --
import "sngl:seq"
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    vbox {
        for seq.count(200000) {
            text(value="x")
        }
    }
}

window {
    main
}
